rows.en: ...He must have been that bitter about losing to Zamsha.
...He must have been that bitter about losing to Zamsha.
Gyaooooooh!!
...!! So it's shown up!?
Gyaaaooooooh!!
Mururoa...!!
Mururoa...!!
Mururoa...!!
Mururoa...!!
So that's Mururoa!!
So that's Mururoa!!
So you're Mururoa, huh!?
So that's Mururoa!!
...!! There you are, Mururoa!!
Mururoa...!?
Mururoa...!?
You're Mururoa, then!?
So you are Mururoa!?
Mururoa spewed black smoke from its entire body!
The black smoke shrouded the whole area in darkness...
Gyaaaooooooh!!
...Ngh.
Gyaaaooooooh!!
...What power!
...Blast that Mururoa! So it's created an environment in its own favor!!
...Blast that Mururoa! So it's created an environment in its own favor!!
...Blast that Mururoa! So it's created an environment in its own favor!!
...Damn that Mururoa! It went and rigged the field in its own favor!
...Mururoa! So it created an environment that works in its favor!
Hm? ...I see! Mururoa has created an environment that favors itself!!
Mururoaaa!! You bastard...!! Pullin' some weird setup so you get the upper hand!
...Blast that Mururoa! So it's created an environment in its own favor, has it!
...Blast that Mururoa! So it's created an environment in its own favor, has it!
Mururoa...! It made itself an environment that...!!
Mururoa...! It made itself an environment that...!!
Mururoa...! It made itself an environment that...!!
Mururoa...! It made itself an environment that...!!
...Looks like this'll be a tough fight. You ready?
Tch, we've got no time to waste. Hurry it up.
Good! Our best bet is to take it down fast. Let's go!!
...We did it.
...That was a formidable foe.
That was quite a tough one.
Alriiight, we did it!!
We somehow managed to beat it...
The darkness has cleared...
Nothin' can stop my momentum!!
We did it!!
Cheap tricks won't work on me!
All right!
That should do it...!
Mission complete.
Target destruction confirmed.
The monitor is showing the details of the next match.

Opponent: Match in progress
Venue: Floor 2 Center, City District B
"Match in progress"...? So our opponent hasn't been decided yet?
Just then, the opponent appeared on the monitor.

Opponent: Alien Alliance
Venue: Floor 2 NW, City District C
What!! If it's the Alien Alliance, that means...
Jack and the others went and lost!?
Jack, Ace...!
Jack, Ace...!
My brothers...? No, there has to be some mistake!!
Jack and Ace!? No way!! There's gotta be some mistake!!
Birth... Isn't this some kind of mistake?
Accel...!! No way... This has gotta be some mistake, right?
Those guys are pathetic! ...All right, I'll get revenge for 'em!
Jack! Ace! Accel! Birth! Were they really defeated!?
I can't believe it...!! That those men would be defeated...
Them...? Isn't this some kind of mistake?
You're kidding, right? Isn't this some kind of mistake?
Isn't this some kind of mistake?
Isn't this some kind of mistake?
This is District B... This is where Jack and the others...
This is District B... This is where Jack and the others...
This is District B... This is where Brother Jack and the others...
This is District B... This is where Jack and the others...
I'm sorry, everyone... We of all people... were defeated by the Alien Alliance...
By the Alien Alliance... we were defeated...
Jack...! ...It couldn't be helped. They're formidable foes.

Roar from the unseen Mururoa (label ???); #0.3/#0.20/#0.22 use one consistent Mururoa roar. No earlier Mururoa roar in finished slices.

Leader blocks in 0429 verified against the event script: #0.4-0.16, #0.24-0.36 and #0.50-0.62 use order Mebius, Ultraman, Seven, Zero, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00; #0.73-0.85 use Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, then the same order.
#0.24-0.26 identical JP (Mebius/Ultraman/Seven) -> identical English; the curse particle rendered 'Blast that'. Mururoa is a kaiju (g=n) -> 'it'.
W variant; script shows W (Philip) as speaker, voiced analytically.
#0.33-0.36 (Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00) trail off mid-sentence in the source; kept unfinished.
Yes/No prompt spoken by Ankh (script shows his name window before YesNoWinIn). #0.41 is Ankh's reply if the player answers No.

Monitor layout kept as two lines with 
, venue style follows story_072 ('Floor 1 SE, City District A'). 'Match in progress' = opponent slot still fighting (it was Jack's team's match at District B).
Mebius; 'nii-san-tachi' = his elder Ultra brothers Jack and Ace -> 'My brothers'.
OOO addresses Birth with -san (dropped per style).
RX calls out the absent four by name; 'they' restored as subject since they are not present.

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader-variant order confirmed from the 0428/0429/0430 event scripts. 0429 #0.38 is Ankh's Yes/No prompt; 0430 #0.6 appears unused by the script. Not in glossary: venue names (City District B/C, Floor 2) follow story_072 style.
